arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: training_path
arg.description: Directory of the BING trained model (ObjNessB2W8*.yml.gz), empty to download opencv_contrib/modules/saliency/samples/ObjectnessTrainedModel to ~/.ros/opencv_apps/models/ at the first time

arg.name: max_objectness
arg.description: Maximum number of objectness to be detected
